Choose one of the four members of the broken hero party and aim to escape the dungeon together. In the trial version, you can play up to the first boss "Exile".

ja.summary: 変なものが大好きで、くだらない話や幽霊の話、ゲーム関連の新ネタなどを日々語っています。シャオ・ルオ先生…そうですか？ (写真/Xiao Luo) 最近、休暇中に友達とラブブックを体験しに行き、新鮮で奇妙な経験をしました。恋愛本の話は昔から聞いていましたし、一緒に遊びに連れて行ってくれた友人もこの分野の達人です。彼女の友達の輪にはいつも男性の顔がいます。これらのビデオでは、相手が彼女の腕の中で息を引き取る、二人が大声で呼び合い、そして別れを告げるなど、ロマンチックなシーンを小さな劇場で演じます。その時は彼女のパートナーだと思って相手の正体を推測し続けていました。後で知ったのですが、ロマンティックなNPCでした。何度か行けなかったのですが、連休中にやっと一緒に会う約束をすることができました。その日の昼、何も知らずに出発し、「遅れたら赤い封筒をもらう」と心配しながら早めに現場に到着した。スタッフさんに「どの役をやるの？」と聞かれました。知りませんでした。

en.title: Weird story: Playing with love books, a father comes from the sky
en.summary: He is very fond of weird things, and talks about nonsense, ghost things, and new things related to games every day. Teacher Xiao Luo...is this right? (Photo / Xiao Luo) Recently, during the holidays, I went to experience a love book with my friends, and had a fresh and strange experience. I have long heard about romance books, and the friend who took me to play with them is also an expert in this category. There are always male faces in her circle of friends. In these videos, they will act out some romantic scenes in a small theater, such as the other party dying in her arms, the two calling each other loudly, and then saying goodbye. At that time, I kept guessing about the other party's identity, thinking that it was her partner. Later I found out that it was a romantic NPC. We couldn't make the trip several times, but during the holidays, we were finally able to make an appointment together. At noon that day, I set out ignorantly, and arrived at the scene early with the worry that "if you are late, you will get a red envelope." The staff asked me: "Which role will you play?" I didn't know.
